instruction: Run `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\sallen_key.cir` in native PSpice. Keep the native simulator artifacts as `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\sallen_key.out`, `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\sallen_key_measure.txt`, and `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\sallen_key.dat`. Then read the nine corner measurement blocks from `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\sallen_key_measure.txt` and write `C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\wc.json` with `BW_nominal`, `BW_min`, `BW_max`, `corner_min`, and `corner_max`, where each `BW_*` value is the highest sampled frequency that remains within 3 dB of that corner's peak sample.
